binding_law: Canonical Character identity/presence uses the CPS-B distributed-recognition architecture beneath optional depiction.
Redundant identity cues must stay sparse, truthful and mutually supportive; they must not become decorative inventory.
Face, portrait, color, costume, pose, lighting, motion, one crop or one emblem may not become sole canonical identity authority.
Authorized current state, authoritative history residue, relational context and optional expressive depiction remain separate layers.
next_boundary: Close CPS-01 continuity, then run a fresh Phase-C post-CPS reentry audit before activating any successor renderer, DUR-01, Phase-D, CLR or Stage-to-shell gate.
